runtime.description: the script runtime executable; the default is "node"

timeoutSeconds.description: the script deadline in seconds (default 30); a call may only tighten it

maxToolCalls.description: the bridged tool-call cap per script (default 100); beyond it calls are refused with a teaching error

capabilities: registers one tool (run) that executes model-written JavaScript in a child process via core/process
the script bridges back through ToolContext.ExecuteToolAsync, so approvals, hooks, nested ids and cancellation stay in the core pipeline
the child starts with a scrubbed environment allow-list; the host's environment (provider keys included) never leaks
annotations: not read-only, destructive-capable, so the call asks
